verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. For each partnership step, the defining reflection interchanges A and C and sends D to E, so it preserves the unordered multiset of boundary side lengths and the area. These two invariants therefore persist throughout any sequence. The cited signed fact 66e0f3ce87e4696d applies to every cyclic ordering of the fixed positive side lengths and fixed positive area, giving at most two congruence classes per ordering; with at most 24 ordered arrangements, there are at most 48 congruence classes in total. Hence an infinite pairwise noncongruent sequence cannot exist. The cited fact's statement contains no unproven conditional premise, and no hard prohibition is triggered.
